title.narrative: Economic and Financial Policy Expert Center

description.narrative: UNOPS supports the initiation of the Economic and Financial Policy Expert Centre. The Centre will focus on leveraging, strengthening and amplifying research, policy analysis and messaging around the policy and regulatory reforms needed to enable the financial system to accelerate delivery of the climate transition. It aims to support government, industry and other public bodies to make the changes required to mitigate the worst effects of climate change this decade.
